
SET str:plain hello
SET str:number 42
SET str:json "{\"name\":\"Ann\",\"tags\":[\"a\",\"b\"],\"n\":{\"x\":1}}"
SET str:unicode "你好 world"
SET str:binary "\x00\x01\xff\xfe"
SET str:long "0123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789"
SET str:ttl expires EX 315360000
HSET hash:user name Ann age 30 email ann@example.com meta "{\"vip\":true}"
HSET hash:binary raw "\x00\x01\xff" text ok
RPUSH list:queue first second third fourth fifth
RPUSH list:dups x y x y x
SADD set:tags red green blue
SADD set:binary "\xff\xfe" plain
ZADD zset:rank 1 alice 2.5 bob 3 carol 3 dave 10 erin
XADD stream:events 1700000000000-1 type login user ann
XADD stream:events 1700000000000-2 type click user ann target button
XADD stream:events 1700000000001-1 type logout user ann
JSON.SET json:doc $ "{\"a\":1,\"b\":[1,2,{\"c\":null}],\"s\":\"text\"}"

SET app:users:1 ann
SET app:users:2 bob
SET app:users:3 carol
SET app:orders:100 o100
SET app:orders:101 o101
SET app:config "{}"
SET app oops
SET cache:session:abc s1
SET cache:session:def s2
SET a::b double
SET :lead start
SET trail: end
SET nodelimiter x

EVAL "for i = 1, 6000 do redis.call('HSET', 'hash:big', 'field' .. i, 'value' .. i) end" 0
EVAL "for i = 1, 12000 do redis.call('SET', 'bulk:' .. i, i) end" 0

SELECT 1
SET other:one 1
SET other:two 2
SELECT 0
SET seed:done 1
